scores.question: Which agreements contain a non-compete clause?
scores.answer:
The following agreements contain non-compete or express restrictions on competing products, services, or endorsements:

- **ADAMSGOLFINC_03_21_2005-EX-10.17-ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT.PDF** — Sections 4–6 restrict endorsements of competing golf products, consulting for competing manufacturers or sellers, and use of competitors’ products in noncompetitive-product endorsements. [ADAMSGOLFINC_03_21_2005-EX-10.17-ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT.PDF pp. 3–4]
- **ASHWORTHINC_01_29_1999-EX-10.(D)-PROMOTION AGREEMENT AND NANTZ COMMUNICATIONS, INC..PDF** — The “Exclusivity” clause prohibits competing sportswear, hat, and shoe endorsements without approval, subject to specified Lynx exceptions. [ASHWORTHINC_01_29_1999-EX-10.(D)-PROMOTION AGREEMENT AND NANTZ COMMUNICATIONS, INC..PDF pp. 3–4]
- **ETELOS,INC_03_09_2004-EX-10.8-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF** — Section 4.2 prohibits the distributor from carrying competitive products without Tripath’s consent. [ETELOS,INC_03_09_2004-EX-10.8-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **FuseMedicalInc_20190321_10-K_EX-10.43_11575454_EX-10.43_Distributor Agreement.pdf** — Section 2.4(f) prohibits the distributor from acting as an agent or buying agent for goods competitive with the Products. [FuseMedicalInc_20190321_10-K_EX-10.43_11575454_EX-10.43_Distributor Agreement.pdf p. 4]
- **GAINSCOINC_01_21_2010-EX-10.41-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF** — Section 2(v) restricts Racing and its members from endorsing competing or inconsistent entities, products, or services without written approval. [GAINSCOINC_01_21_2010-EX-10.41-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **HERTZGLOBALHOLDINGS,INC_07_07_2016-EX-10.4-INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AGREEMENT.PDF** — Section 9, “Non-Competition,” restricts HERC and its affiliates from specified vehicle-rental activities during the Interim Period, subject to exceptions. [HERTZGLOBALHOLDINGS,INC_07_07_2016-EX-10.4-INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AGREEMENT.PDF p. 9]
- **SCOUTCAMINC_05_12_2020-EX-10.22-SERVICES AGREEMENT.PDF** — Section 8 prohibits Maimon from competing with the Company during the agreement and for two years afterward. [SCOUTCAMINC_05_12_2020-EX-10.22-SERVICES AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **SteelVaultCorp_20081224_10-K_EX-10.16_3074935_EX-10.16_Affiliate Agreement.pdf** — Section 4 prohibits marketing similar competing products on landing pages containing the specified web links while the agreement is effective. [SteelVaultCorp_20081224_10-K_EX-10.16_3074935_EX-10.16_Affiliate Agreement.pdf p. 2]
- **TodosMedicalLtd_20190328_20-F_EX-4.10_11587157_EX-4.10_Marketing Agreement_ Reseller Agreement.pdf** — Section 4.12 prohibits the reseller from marketing, distributing, or selling competing products or providing services to Todos’s direct competitors. [TodosMedicalLtd_20190328_20-F_EX-4.10_11587157_EX-4.10_Marketing Agreement_ Reseller Agreement.pdf p. 4]

**Redacted provision:** **BellringBrandsInc_20190920_S-1_EX-10.12_11817081_EX-10.12_Manufacturing Agreement1.pdf** contains Section 18, “Non-Exclusivity and Non-Competition,” but subsection 18(b) is redacted, so its substantive restriction cannot be confirmed. [BellringBrandsInc_20190920_S-1_EX-10.12_11817081_EX-10.12_Manufacturing Agreement1.pdf pp. 11–12]
